seed109_real_beats_permuted_median_100re.rule: real signed_sum PV < permuted median PV (100 repeats)

seed109_real_beats_80pct_permuted.rule: real PV beats >= 80% of 100 permuted repeats

seed109_evidence_arrives_too_late.rule: first useful key appears after episode 3 or episodes remaining <= 1

no_oracle_leakage_confirmed.rule: all online variants use no offline/oracle evidence

shared_positions_used.rule: all variants use the same precomputed episode positions

permuted_control_mode_is_online_stepwise.rule: C variants learn online and permute at decision time

final_memory_permutation_used.rule: no variant uses final-memory post-hoc permutation

hard_exclusion_used.rule: hard_exclusion is always false for all variants

deceptive_family_preservation_valid.rule: all deceptive objects preserve expected family identity

implementation_status.rule: pass if sanity ok and signed_sum beats A and permuted_median; partial/fail otherwise

failure_reason.rule: derived from seed 109 high-ceiling gap diagnostic results
